about: The WebAssembly file of each wallet-tools page (docs/design/architect/ARCHITECTURE.md section 9, ADR 0007): per edition and page, the binding's browser-* modules and the library's unit features built into it. cargo xtask wasm build <edition>/<page> builds one; cargo xtask wasm verify checks them all. A profile gains a module with the increment that builds it. The edition test holds profiles for the gates alone, such as test/probe, whose module probe no page profile may take.
